bio.karatzis: Maths from the first year of middle school to advanced high school maths, patiently and methodically, until the student solves it alone.
bio.manthaiaki: Language, literature and ancient Greek. She starts on essay writing early, so that by the final year it is not the frightening part.
bio.athanasaki: Language subjects across middle and high school, with the emphasis on understanding a text before memorising it.
bio.triamatakis: Maths for middle and high school. He starts from where the gap was left, not from today's chapter.
bio.kallergi: Computer science and digital tools, so that a computer becomes a way to learn rather than only a way to pass the time.

About.title: About us
About.intro: Two teachers who opened their own school in Venerato, and a team that grew around them.
About.storyOne: Peri Paideias was founded by Vasilis Karatzis and Maria Manthaiaki, after many years of teaching in classrooms and one to one.
About.storyTwo: Through daily contact with students and families they understood something simple: supporting a child does not stop at the syllabus. It needs a place they are happy to come to, a timetable that holds up, and someone who notices that something is wrong before the grade says so.
About.storyThree: So they built a school of small classes for the children of Venerato and the villages around it, from primary school all the way to the national exams.
About.teamIntro: Five teachers. The student knows who is in front of them, and we know what each of us is doing.
